title: Factors Influencing Filtration Efficiency: A Focus on Smoke
summary: This text discusses several factors that influence filtration efficiency, specifically focusing on smoke. The physical processes of smoke filtration primarily occur through three mechanisms: direct interception, Brownian diffusion, and inertial impaction.

results.fiber_orientation: play a role in filtration efficiency

air_dilution.cluno: increases filtration efficiency by lowering smoke velocity

dpf.low_dpf_filters: have high filter efficiency due to an inverse relationship with the number of fibers
